# Pelbu Suites

Pelbu Suites is a hotel in Olakha, Thimphu, Bhutan. Direct booking is the
primary conversion path. Prices, availability, hours and policies must be taken
from the live pages, not inferred from this index.

- Location: Olakha, Thimphu, Bhutan
- Guest path: pick dates on home or /book; public BAR on /rates

- On site: guest rooms, cafe, pastry, restaurant, bar, spa/steam, meeting
